value.name: asha slides journal to daniel
value.description: Asha moves their mother's journal across the table until its open page sits under Daniel's hand.
evidence: Asha eased the journal across the table until its open edge slid beneath Daniel's flattened hand

value.name: daniel feels the final entry
value.description: Daniel keeps his hand on the page, testing the writing beneath it and reacting physically to the discovery.
evidence: so that the last entry in their mother's thin late ink lay directly under his palm
He did not lift his hand at once; he held it there a moment as if testing what was beneath it
Asha watched the knuckles whiten faintly before he drew back, slow, the way a man pulls away from something hot

value.name: daniel withdraws from the page
value.description: Daniel slowly pulls his hand away from the journal after sensing the significance of what is written there.
evidence: he drew back, slow, the way a man pulls away from something hot

value.name: daniel avoids asha's gaze
value.description: After withdrawing, Daniel looks at his own hand instead of meeting Asha's eyes, showing discomfort or hesitation.
evidence: When his hand was off the page he looked at it instead of at her

value.name: daniel asks who witnessed signature
value.description: Daniel asks who saw the final signature, shifting the scene into a more pointed legal inquiry.
evidence: he said, without quite finding her eyes, "Who witnessed the final signature?"

value.name: rosa withholds an answer
value.description: Rosa stays silent instead of answering Daniel's question, forcing the moment to linger.
evidence: Rosa, on the far side of the lamp, did not answer; she only let the silence sit long enough that Daniel had to hear himself having asked
